# RestAreaNearMe

> Highway rest areas and NHAI wayside amenities across India's major corridors, with a source on every row.

## What this site covers
- Rest areas and wayside amenities on NH48, NH44, NH19, NH16, the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway and the Yamuna Expressway.
- Practical guidance: break every 2 hours or 150 km, choose lit and staffed stops, fuel courts are the safest 24x7 default.

## Pages
- / — hub, corridor list, FAQ
- /corridor/{slug}/ — documented stops per corridor
- /rest-area-near-me/ · /rest-stop-near-me/ · /highway-rest-area-near-me/
- /about/ · /methodology/ · /privacy/

## Data policy
Coordinates, opening times and amenities are published only when sourced. Unverified values render as "not published".
